# Templates

## Opening balances (MW import)

Use `opening_balances_import.csv` for the AAS UI/MW opening balance import feature.

- Accepts ERPNext IDs or **exact** names (names must be unique).
- Categories are ERPNext **Item Group** (by ID or exact `item_group_name`).

## Opening balance Journal Entry (ERPNext import)

`opening_balance_journal_entry.csv` is an ERPNext Journal Entry import-style CSV and is **not** compatible with the AAS UI/MW opening balance import.
